spans.s:
भेक भेक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. भी),
a frog, (according to the Kathā-sarit-sāgara

,
the inarticulate sounds uttered by frogs were the
result of the curse of Agni, who was betrayed by
them to the gods when he took refuge in the water);
a cloud; a timid man (= भीरु; cf. भेल); (ई), f.
a female frog; a small frog; a kind of creeper,
Hydrocotyle Asiatica.
—भेक-पर्णी, f. ‘frog-
leaved,’ a plant (= मण्डूक-पर्णी).
—भेक-
भुज्, क्, m. ‘frog-eater,’ a serpent, snake.
—भेक-
शब्द, अस्, m. the croaking of frogs.

भेकुरि भेकुरि, इस्, f., Ved., N. of particular
asterisms (according to Colebrooke ‘nymphs of the
moon,’ cf. Vājasaneyi-saṃhitā

, where भेकुरि is explained
by भाकुरि).
